entries.title: #1 SYSTEMIC: catch(Exception) -> response(['message'=>$e->getMessage()],422) leaks internal/SQL messages to client; 97/104 files log NOTHING
entries.count: 434 leak lines across 104 controllers (Admin-only: 360 lines / 78 controllers). Of the 104 files, 97 have ZERO Log:: anywhere (observability-blind); only 7 contain any Log:: call.
entries.impact: Leaks raw exception text (SQL errors, integrity-constraint names, file paths, class names) to the HTTP client = information disclosure. 97 files swallow the error with no Log:: -> production failures are invisible (no trace, no alert). Generic 422 status hides 500-class faults from monitoring.
entries.evidence: grep -rnE "['\"]message['\"]\s*=>\s*\$(e|exception|ex)->getMessage" app/Http/Controllers => 434 lines. Per-file Log:: presence loop => 97 of 104 files have no Log::. Example app/Http/Controllers/Admin/AnalyticController.php:33-34,43-44,52-53,62-63,73-74 (6 catch blocks, all return getMessage(), file has no Log::). Scope-minimal fix: a shared trait jsonError($e) that Log::error()s the real message + returns a generic translated 422 ('label.something_went_wrong'). 104-file sweep = too broad for one pass; do it system-by-system, highest-risk controllers first (Pos*, Order*, Payment*, Loyalty*).

entries.title: appService.currencyFormat hardcodes en-US toFixed (no FR thousands/decimal separator) -> '0.00EUR' not '0,00 EUR'
entries.count: 13 files reference it; the method itself does parseFloat(amount).toFixed(decimal)+currency with NO Intl/locale. 9 components render prices through it (vs the FR-correct kiosk formatPrice SSOT).
entries.impact: Money is shown in en-US notation (dot decimal, no FR comma, no NBSP) on the public web site, table-ordering, and POS payment screens. Inconsistent with the kiosk's locale-correct formatPrice() and FR-locale ADR-007. User-facing correctness debt.
entries.evidence: Read appService.js:71-77. grep -rln currencyFormat resources/js => 13 files. Fix scope-minimal: make currencyFormat use Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR') (or reuse kiosk formatPrice logic). Pure presentation, no backend/NF525 SSOT change (prices stay backend-computed). EXCEPT it also feeds PaymentComponent.vue (frozen) -> see frozen-zone entry.

entries.title: en-US money consumer list: every non-kiosk price surface routes through appService.currencyFormat instead of the FR formatPrice() SSOT
entries.count: 12 .vue consumers (excluding appService.js def): admin/pos/ItemComponent.vue:308, admin/pos/PosComponent.vue:815/835/1145, admin/pos/PaymentComponent.vue:28/101/186/203/219 (FROZEN), frontend/checkout/CheckoutComponent.vue:185/229/240/254/268, frontend/checkout/CouponComponent.vue:65, frontend/components/ItemComponent.vue:272, layouts/frontend/FrontendCartComponent.vue:66/113, layouts/frontend/FrontendNavBarComponent.vue:62, layouts/table/TableCartComponent.vue:40/85, layouts/table/TableNavBarComponent.vue:15/56, table/checkout/CheckoutComponent.vue:82/121/133, table/components/ItemComponent.vue:277.
entries.impact: FR-locale inconsistency surface = the entire web/table/POS money UI. Kiosk (BORNE) uses formatPrice() and is FR-correct; everything else is en-US. Two parallel money-formatting code paths = drift risk + visible inconsistency between systems.
entries.evidence: grep -rln currencyFormat resources/js. Fixing the single appService.currencyFormat def (above) heals 11 of 12 consumers at once. PaymentComponent.vue is FROZEN (see frozen-zone entry) -> stuck.

entries.title: currencyFormat method body copy-pasted verbatim across 5 components (mixin candidate)
entries.count: 5 byte-identical method bodies: currencyFormat(amount,decimal,currency,position){ return appService.currencyFormat(...); }. floatNumber referenced in 19 .vue files (same duplication shape).
entries.impact: Pure copy-paste maintenance debt. A change to currency rendering must be made in N places. These 5 are trivial 1-line delegators that could be a shared mixin or just call appService directly in template.
entries.evidence: grep -nA4 'currencyFormat(amount, decimal, currency, position)' on each file shows identical 1-line delegator. Fix: a moneyMixin (currencyFormat+floatNumber) or import appService directly. PaymentComponent.vue:535 copy is FROZEN.

entries.title: Governance debt: 66 FormRequest authorize() bare 'return true;' (authz fully deferred to middleware)

entries.title: Governance debt UNI-03: prod cache-driver guard only forbids ['array','null']; 'file' and 'database' PASS
entries.count: Forbidden list = ['array','null'] (2 entries). 'file' + 'database' drivers pass the boot guard despite the exception message claiming intent is 'shared driver (redis or memcached)'.
entries.impact: V1 LOCAL single-box 'file' driver is SAFE (one FPM pool, Cache::lock coherent for NF525 audit-chain). On multi-instance/ALB cloud, 'file' breaks cross-worker lock coherence -> risk of UNIQUE(branch_id,prev_hash) collision / silent fiscal-chain break. This is the documented UNI-03 cloud-prep backlog item.
entries.evidence: AppServiceProvider.php:294 $cacheDriver=config('cache.default'); :295 $forbiddenCacheDrivers=['array','null']; :296 in_array -> throw RuntimeException. Matches CLAUDE.md §8 UNI-03. STALE DOC: CLAUDE.md §8 cites AppServiceProvider.php:215; real line is 294-296 (doc-only correction). Widening list only required at cloud cutover (owner-gate).
